description: This Java class defines a Swing-based GUI form for comparing images and their associated data (such as tables from ROM files). It allows users to select two images, compare their tables, and view differences, similarities, and missing tables visually and via a list.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm
classes.description: A JFrame-based GUI for comparing two images and their associated ROM tables, highlighting differences and similarities with a list and color-coded labels.

classes.name: ComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for combo boxes to display ROM file names.

classes.name: ChangeListCellRenderer
classes.description: Custom renderer for list items indicating table comparison status with color coding.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: A simple data container class holding a comparison item type and value for display in the list.

methods.name: CompareImagesForm
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the comparison form, set up GUI components and populate combo boxes with ROMs.

methods.name: findAndShowTable
methods.description: Finds a table in a given ROM by name and displays it in the editor.

methods.name: populateComboBoxes
methods.description: Fills the image selection combo boxes with available ROMs.

methods.name: compareTables
methods.description: Compares the tables of the two selected ROMs, updating the UI with differences, similarities, and missing tables.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles actions such as clicking the compare button to trigger table comparison.
